text:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: High latency & streaming stalls observed. Alert: streaming-endpoints.slo.p99 breach in eu-west-2 and us-west-2. Paging oncall (P1). Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/alerts/98765

maya.d: I'm oncall, ack. Seeing p95 jump ~120ms -> ~700ms, p99 from ~1.8s -> ~9s. Streaming chunk delays >5s for many sessions. Kicking off triage.

jordan: adding @network-op @eng-oncall and @customer-success. Any obvious deploys?

maya.d: no service deploys in last 30m from our side. Looks networky — high retransmits and DNS lookup latency spikes correlated.

network-op: digging in VPC/NAT metrics for eu-west-2: NAT connection tracking at ~94%, SNAT pool usage spiking, retransmits high between az-b <-> az-c.

network-op: quick tcp stats snapshot from the NAT host:```
TcpExt: RetransSegs=42137 FastRetrans=1205 ForwardRetrans=8400
TcpExt: ListenDrops=0 TCPTimeouts=230
```

leo.s: traceroute from streaming-worker-azb -> model-host shows extra 110-140ms between AZ B and AZ C, odd asymmetry on the egress path.

samir: TLS handshake fail counts up 5x in logs: `handshake_timeout` and `cert_verify_retry`. Most handshakes not completing within 2s. Suspect retransmit-induced handshake stalls.

maya.d: customer impact: hosted streaming clients (chat stream + websocket sessions) see stalled frames and reconnects. CS, which customers are hitting this hardest?

customer-success: top affected: acme-ai (eu), beta-saas (global), and demo-tenant-23. Notified account leads, holding off public comms until we have a mitigation.

maya.d: mitigation plan (short-term):
1) increase NAT conntrack and ephemeral port range on eu-west-2 gateways
2) rebalance SNAT allocations to secondary egress pool (warm standby)
3) add temporary egress route preference to eu-west-1 for new streaming sessions (non-pinned)
4) enable DNS TTL short-circuit for model hostnames to avoid resolver stalls
5) keep monitoring p95/p99 + streaming chunk latency

eng-oncall: can we do steps 1+2 now? I can apply sysctl and adjust SNAT allocation. If that doesn't work, we'll flip the route preference.

network-op: applying conntrack bump and ephemeral port range now. Commands:```
# on nat-gw-eu-west-2
sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=2000000
sudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range="15000 65000"
# redistribute SNAT pools
redistribute-snat --from=pool-primary --to=pool-secondary --percent=30
```

network-op: applied. Watching metrics.

pagerduty-bot: NOTE: oncall handoff scheduled in 30m. Escalate to infra if unresolved.

maya.d: 2m after changes: p95 fell to ~180ms, p99 to ~800ms, streaming stalls rate dropped ~70%. Good improvement but still seeing ~5% residual spikes near 20-30s.

leo.s: still seeing a trickle of flows hitting a stale TGW route that blackholes traffic between az-b and az-c. I have a patch ready to update route table to remove stale prefix. Applying now.

network-op: TGW route patched, BGP adj refreshed. Flow logs show draining of previously blackholed connections.

samir: TLS handshake failures reduced to near baseline after route fix + conntrack bump. Verified handshake latency distribution improved.

maya.d: routing + NAT fixes together brought p99 back under SLO. Streaming frame stalls subsided. Continuing monitoring for 15m before declaring resolved.

customer-success: updating affected accounts: provided interim summary and ETA for postmortem. They're appreciative of the quick mitigation.

eng-oncall: action items assigned before postmortem:
- (eng-platform) automated SNAT warm-pool rebalancing and test harness (owner: @jordan)
- (network-op) add conntrack >80% alert and ephemeral port exhaustion alarm (owner: @network-op)
- (eng-runtime) add synthetic cross-AZ streaming tail test in canary (owner: @leo.s)
- (product) evaluate more aggressive regional failover policy for short-lived streaming sessions (owner: @maya.d)

maya.d: preparing incident postmortem draft and timeline. Will include metric snapshots, root cause (stale TGW route + insufficient NAT capacity under asymmetric retransmit load), and mitigations.

pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: P1 cleared. Time to mitigation baseline: ~00:12:45 from page to p99 recovery. Create postmortem and link here when ready. :white_check_mark:
